name: Mythic Paper
description: Handmade rag paper, deckle-edged cut layers and public-domain photo plates staged as a lamp-lit diorama; mineral pigments (sindoor vermilion, lapis, turmeric, malachite) with gold leaf. Default look of the mythic-tale template.

tokens.texture: Rag-paper fibre (Studio.texture.grain, multiply), deckle edges (#st-deckle / Studio.kit.mythic.sheet), warm lamp vignette
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Reverent and handmade: sheets placed by hand, slow settles, lamp-light breathing; no overshoot on sacred figures
motion.notes: Sacred figures enter by rising or unveiling, never by bouncing. Gold is for leaf, haloes, borders and display type only.

contrast_checked: Below 4.5:1 (accent-3/paper 3.3:1): leaf, borders, shapes and display type 24px+ only; never body or caption text

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-23. Frame-reviewed in Playwright Chromium on Windows through the mythic-film scaffold; not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the M2 host.
